h: The sort table doesn't wake up until the house goes quiet. 🌙
t: Day job ends, dinner happens, then the desk lamp comes on and the piles come out. That's the dad hustle — the business fits around the family, not the other way around. An hour…

h: The mail doesn't care about your tracking refresh button. 📬
t: eBay Standard Envelope moves slow and quiet. No scan for days, then it just shows up. I used to sweat every package that went dark for 48 hours. Now I pack it right, drop it, and…

h: The fix stopped itself last night. And that's the whole point. 🛑
t: Ran a batch of listing repairs overnight. 9 cards fixed and verified. 2 more got held — not broken, held. The guard read their live category and it didn't match the record from 12…
Friday, November 27, 4:20 PM — the main Whatnot show. One-buck-start singles. The countdown to 1,000 sales is still running — 121 to go.

h: I couldn't find drive mode on my own site. So it's getting a button. 🚗
t: Top of the Stay Curious page. One tap, press play, listen on the drive. The fullscreen shorts feed is coming with it — one swipe, one short, the rest pause.

h: Every card that comes in gets one question: where does it live now? 🗂️
t: Dupes and anything 20 bucks and up go to eBay. The small stuff feeds the Whatnot piles.
